license_required.quote: it shall be unlawful for any person to practice or to offer to practice engineering or land surveying in this State, or to use the title professional engineer or land surveyor or any other title, sign, card or device in such manner as to tend to convey the impression that such person is practicing engineering or land surveying or is a professional engineer or land surveyor, unless such person is duly licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

issuing_authority.value: State Board of Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors
issuing_authority.quote: Said board, when so appointed, shall be designated and known as the "State Board of Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors."

name.value: State Board of Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors
name.quote: Said board, when so appointed, shall be designated and known as the "State Board of Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors."

type.quote: there is hereby created an examining board for the licensing of professional engineers and land surveyors, and the certification of engineers-in-training

moral_character_required.quote: All applicants shall be of good character and reputation.

degree_required.value: Graduation from a board approved curriculum in engineering of four years or more
degree_required.quote: Graduation from a board approved curriculum in engineering of four years or more; a specific record of an additional four years or more of experience in engineering work of a character satisfactory to the board

accrediting_body.quote: Graduation from a board approved curriculum in engineering of four years or more

degree_level.quote: Graduation from a board approved curriculum in engineering of four years or more

credential_pegged.quote: Graduation from a board approved curriculum in engineering of four years or more; a specific record of an additional four years or more of experience in engineering work of a character satisfactory to the board, and indicating that the applicant is competent to be placed in responsible charge of such work; and successfully passing all parts of the written examination

tiers.quote: Graduation from a board approved curriculum in engineering of four years or more; a specific record of an additional four years or more of experience in engineering work
Graduation from a board approved curriculum in engineering technology of four years or more; a specific record of an additional six years or more of experience in engineering work

required.quote: a specific record of an additional four years or more of experience in engineering work of a character satisfactory to the board, and indicating that the applicant is competent to be placed in responsible charge of such work

experience_source.quote: a specific record of an additional four years or more of experience in engineering work of a character satisfactory to the board, and indicating that the applicant is competent to be placed in responsible charge of such work

duration.value: four years or more (engineering curriculum); six years or more (engineering technology curriculum); 15 years or more (alternative path)
duration.quote: a specific record of an additional four years or more of experience in engineering work of a character satisfactory to the board

kind.quote: experience in engineering work of a character satisfactory to the board, and indicating that the applicant is competent to be placed in responsible charge of such work

exams.name: Part F – Fundamentals of Engineering
exams.notes: Required for engineer-in-training certificate and as part of the full PE licensure path (engineering curriculum, 4-year experience track)
exams.quote: Part F--Fundamentals of Engineering--This examination is intended to assess the applicant's competency in the fundamental engineering subjects and basic engineering sciences

exams.name: Part P – Specialized Training
exams.notes: Required for full PE licensure; also available as sole exam for 15-year experience alternative path
exams.quote: Part P--Specialized Training--This examination is intended to assess the extent of the applicant's more advanced and specialized professional training and experience especially in his chosen field of engineering.

interval_years.quote: Licensees shall apply for renewal on or before the thirtieth day of April of each year.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: Renewal of any certificate issued under this chapter may be effected at any time during the month of April by the payment of the fee of five dollars ($5.00).

required.quote: The State Board of Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors shall require each person licensed as a professional engineer, as a condition for biennial licensure pursuant to P.L.1938, c.342 (C.45:8-27 et seq.) and P.L.1972, c.108 (C.45:1-7), to complete not more than 24 credits of continuing professional competency relating to the practice of professional engineering

hours_per_period.quote: to complete not more than 24 credits of continuing professional competency relating to the practice of professional engineering, as provided in section 2 of this act, during each biennial registration period.

topical_requirements.quote: Two of the 24 credits of continuing professional competency required pursuant to section 1 of this act shall be in professional practice ethics.

available.quote: A certificate of registration, issued by any state or territory or possession of the United States, or of any country, may, in the discretion of the board, be accepted as minimum evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant is qualified for registration as a professional engineer

requirements.value: Out-of-state certificate accepted at board's discretion if minimum requirements for examination and license by the issuing agency were at least comparable to NJ requirements at time of application, and applicant has not failed any portion of a nationally administered two-day examination required by the board taken to receive licensure by the issuing agency.
requirements.quote: provided that the minimum requirements for examination and license by the issuing agency in effect at the time of application to the issuing agency, which the applicant satisfied in order to qualify for examination by that issuing agency, are at least comparable to those same minimum requirements of the board which were in effect in this State at that time; and provided that the applicant has not failed any portion of a nationally administered, two-day examination, required by the board, that was taken in order to receive licensure by the issuing agency.

exists.quote: Said board, when so appointed, shall be designated and known as the "State Board of Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors."

national_association.value: National Council of Examiners for Engineering and Surveying
national_association.quote: Establish standards for continuing professional competency in professional engineering, including the subject matter and content of courses of study, which shall be in conformity with a national model, such as that of the National Council of Examiners for Engineering and Surveying

regulatory_model.quote: it shall be unlawful for any person to practice or to offer to practice engineering or land surveying in this State, or to use the title professional engineer or land surveyor or any other title, sign, card or device in such manner as to tend to convey the impression that such person is practicing engineering or land surveying or is a professional engineer or land surveyor, unless such person is duly licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

credential_type.quote: The board shall issue a license certificate upon payment of the application fee as provided in this chapter, to any applicant who, in the opinion of the board, has satisfactorily met all the requirements of this chapter

is_mandatory.quote: it shall be unlawful for any person to practice or to offer to practice engineering or land surveying in this State, or to use the title professional engineer or land surveyor or any other title, sign, card or device in such manner as to tend to convey the impression that such person is practicing engineering or land surveying or is a professional engineer or land surveyor, unless such person is duly licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

title_protection.quote: it shall be unlawful for any person to practice or to offer to practice engineering or land surveying in this State, or to use the title professional engineer or land surveyor or any other title, sign, card or device in such manner as to tend to convey the impression that such person is practicing engineering or land surveying or is a professional engineer or land surveyor, unless such person is duly licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: it shall be unlawful for any person to practice or to offer to practice engineering or land surveying in this State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving false or forged evidence to the board to obtain a certificate of license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: who shall give false or forged evidence of any kind to the board, or to any member or representative thereof, in obtaining a certificate of license
who shall falsely impersonate another licensed practitioner of like or different name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using an expired, revoked, or retired-status certificate of license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: who shall use or attempt to use an expired certificate of license, an unexpired and revoked certificate of license, or a certificate of license which is on a retired status list

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presenting or attempting to file as one's own the certificate of license of another
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any person presenting or attempting to file as his own the certificate of license of another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice professional engineering without being legally authorized
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person who, hereafter, is not legally authorized to practice professional engineering or land surveying in this State according to the provisions of this act, who shall so practice or offer so to practice in this State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using the title 'Engineer-in-Training' or 'Surveyor-in-Training' without holding a valid certificate of registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: who shall use either the title "Engineer-in-Training" or "Surveyor-in-Training" without holding a valid certificate of registration issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional misconduct for violating the Building Design Services Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: discipline any professional engineer who, or business association authorized to offer engineering services which, violates that act. Such a violation shall be deemed professional misconduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to complete continuing professional competency requirements (second or subsequent offense deemed professional misconduct)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A second or subsequent offense by a licensee shall be considered professional misconduct pursuant to the provisions of P.L.1938, c.342 (C.45:8-27 et seq.) and P.L.1978, c.73 (C.45:1-14 et seq.).

establishment_regulation_required.quote: No corporation shall offer to provide engineering services in this State unless issued a certificate of authorization pursuant to this amendatory and supplementary act.

definition_quote.value: any service or creative work the adequate performance of which requires engineering education, training, and experience and the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical and engineering sciences to such services or creative work as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning and design of engineering works and systems, planning the use of land and water, engineering studies, and the administration of construction for the purpose of determining compliance with drawings and specifications
definition_quote.quote: any service or creative work the adequate performance of which requires engineering education, training, and experience and the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical and engineering sciences to such services or creative work as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning and design of engineering works and systems, planning the use of land and water, engineering studies, and the administration of construction for the purpose of determining compliance with drawings and specifications

value: design of engineering works and systems
planning the use of land and water
methods_authorized.quote: consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning and design of engineering works and systems, planning the use of land and water, engineering studies, and the administration of construction for the purpose of determining compliance with drawings and specifications

covers_land_surveying.quote: there is hereby created an examining board for the licensing of professional engineers and land surveyors, and the certification of engineers-in-training

engineer_intern_certificate_available.quote: The examining board shall be empowered to issue a certificate of registration as "Engineer-in-Training" or "Surveyor-in-Training," as the case may be, to an applicant who meets the qualifications outlined elsewhere herein.

surveyor_in_training_certificate_availab.quote: Applications for a certificate of registration as "surveyor-in-training" shall be on forms prescribed and furnished by the board

postgraduate_degree_experience_credit_ye.quote: Completion of a master's degree in engineering shall be considered as equivalent to one year of engineering experience and completion of a doctor's degree in engineering shall be considered as equivalent to one additional year of engineering experience.

responsible_charge_defined.quote: The term "responsible charge" as used in this chapter for professional engineers shall mean the provision of regular and effective supervision by a competent professional engineer who shall provide personal direction to, and quality control over, the efforts of subordinates of the licensee which directly and materially affect the quality and competence of the professional services rendered by the licensee.

seal_required_on_documents.quote: Plans, specifications, plats, and reports issued by persons authorized under this chapter shall be sealed with said seal, during the life of the licensee's certificate, but it shall be unlawful for anyone to stamp or seal any documents with said seal after the certificate of the licensee named thereon has expired, has been revoked, or is on a retired status list

seal_document_types.quote: Plans, specifications, plats, and reports issued by persons authorized under this chapter shall be sealed with said seal

firm_practice_allowed.quote: The board shall issue a certificate of authorization to certain corporations and those corporations shall be authorized to offer professional engineering and land surveying services or both

value: Nonresident persons not practicing more than 30 consecutive days per calendar year who are legally qualified in another state or country with comparable requirements
Nonresident persons or recent residents who have filed an application for a certificate of license and paid the required fee, pending board consideration
Employees or subordinates of a licensed person, provided practice does not include responsible charge of design or supervision
Officers and employees of the Government of the United States while engaged in professional engineering for said government
Practice of engineering solely as an officer or employee of a corporation engaged in interstate commerce, unless affecting public safety or health
Persons practicing engineering on property owned or leased by such person, firm or corporation, unless involving public safety, public health or public welfare
exemptions_from_licensure.quote: The following shall be exempted from the provisions of this chapter

board_member_responsible_charge_years_re.quote: Appointees, other than the two public members and the State executive department member appointed pursuant to the provisions of P.L. 1971, c. 60 (C. 45:1-2.1 et seq.) and the two appointees added pursuant to this 1985 amendatory act, shall have been licensed as professional engineers in New Jersey for a period of at least five years

pdh_units_per_renewal_period.quote: to complete not more than 24 credits of continuing professional competency relating to the practice of professional engineering, as provided in section 2 of this act, during each biennial registration period.

pdh_carryover_max_units.quote: The board shall allow a professional engineer to carry over a maximum of 12 continuing professional competency credits to the next biennial licensure period.

retired_status_license_available.quote: A licensed professional engineer or land surveyor who has been licensed for a minimum of 25 years and is 62 years of age or older may apply to the board for retirement license status on a form furnished by the board.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Federal government officers and employees practicing engineering in official capacity
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Officers and employees of the Government of the United States while engaged within this State in the practice of professional engineering or land surveying, for said government.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Contractors executing work designed by a licensed engineer (construction execution only)
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: The mere execution, as a contractor, of work designed by a professional engineer, or the supervision of construction of such work as a foreman or superintendent, or the observation of construction as an inspector or witness shall not be deemed to be experience in engineering work.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Building trades workers, craft workers, and construction superintendents/supervisors/inspectors performing customary duties
Employees or subordinates working under direct supervision of a licensed engineer
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: An employee or a subordinate of a person holding a license under this chapter or an employee of a person exempted from license by subsections (1) and (2) of this section; provided, this practice does not include responsible charge of design or supervision.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Engineers-in-training / engineer interns acting under supervision
Land surveyor interns
Teaching engineering, architectural, landscape architectural, or surveying courses at accredited institutions
Regulated transportation companies and public utilities (and their officers and employees) performing engineering for their own facilities
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: The practice of engineering or land surveying solely as an officer or employee of a corporation engaged in interstate commerce as defined in an act of Congress entitled "Act to regulate commerce," approved February 4, 1887, and as amended, unless the same affects public safety or health.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Engineering services incidental to the practice of architecture by licensed architects and their subordinates
Engineering services incidental to the practice of geology by licensed geologists and their subordinates
Practice of any other legally recognized profession or trade
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: This chapter shall not be construed to affect or prevent the practice of any other legally recognized profession.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Manufacturing, mining, public utility, research and development, or other industrial corporations performing engineering work incidental to their own products, systems, or services
Firms performing engineering services for themselves or their own subsidiaries/affiliates (in-house engineering)
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Nothing in this act shall be construed as required licensing for the purpose of practicing professional engineering or land surveying by any person, firm, or corporation upon property owned or leased by such person, firm or corporation, unless the same involves the public safety, public health or public welfare.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Nonresident persons, firms, or corporations meeting specified out-of-state criteria
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: A person not a resident of and having no established place of business in this State, practicing or offering to practice herein professional engineering or land surveying within the meaning and intent of this chapter, when such practice does not exceed in the aggregate 30 consecutive days in any calendar year; provided, such person is legally qualified by license to practice said professional engineering or land surveying in any State or country in which the requirements and qualifications for a certificate of license are at least comparable to those specified in this chapter.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Real estate brokers or salespersons making appraisals and valuations of real estate
Alterations or repairs to buildings not affecting structural system or public health, safety, or welfare
Single-family and small residential dwellings of limited size
Agricultural work not required to be of public record
Revegetation, restoration, reclamation, rehabilitation, or erosion control for disturbed land not affecting public health, safety, or welfare
Maintenance or placement of plant material not affecting public health, safety, or welfare
Horticultural consultants and persons preparing planting plans for plant installations
Authorized designers of fire protection systems
Holders of temporary permits for engineering practice
Corporations, partnerships, LLCs, and LLPs offering professional engineering services through licensed principals (business entity exemption with certificate of authorization)
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: The board shall issue a certificate of authorization to certain corporations and those corporations shall be authorized to offer professional engineering and land surveying services or both

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Government employees inspecting residential structures as part of official duties
Persons performing home inspections solely for lender construction monitoring
Property managers inspecting their own managed residential structures without separate compensation
Small public works projects below a specified expenditure threshold
Licensed geologists practicing geology (not required to hold engineer license)
Persons with grandfathered or legacy licensure status in discontinued engineering branch titles
Boundary surveys on private land not intended as basis for engineering design
Professional engineers or engineer interns granted inactive status
Senior licensed professional engineers exempt from continuing education requirements
